description: The bar chart displays the Shapley value for three models—mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and chLSTM (green)—across nine distinct categories labeled along the horizontal axis as L_4^+, L_3, L_2, L_1, T, R_1, R_2, R_3, and R_4^+. The vertical axis represents the 'Shapley value' on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks spaced at intervals of 20 units. Each category on the horizontal axis contains a grouped set of three bars, one for each model, allowing for direct visual comparison within each category. The tallest bars are found in the 'T' category, where the chLSTM model reaches a value of 80, the XLM-R model is approximately 70, and the mBERT model is approximately 50. In all other categories—L_4^+, L_3, L_2, L_1, R_1, R_2, R_3, and R_4^+—the bars are significantly shorter, with values generally below 15. A legend in the top right corner identifies each model by its corresponding color. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting of categories along the horizontal axis, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their standard presentation.
caption_used: The bar chart illustrates the Shapley value for different models across various categories. The horizontal axis represents the categories labeled as L_4^+, L_3, L_2, L_1, T, R_1, R_2, R_3, R_4^+, while the vertical axis represents the 'Shapley value,' measured on a linear scale from 0 to 80 with tick intervals of 20 units. Bars are grouped by category, with each group containing three bars representing different models: mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and chLSTM (green). The tallest bars appear in category T, where mBERT has an approximate value of 50, XLM-R about 70, and chLSTM reaching the maximum value of 80. In other categories such as L_4^+, L_3, L_2, L_1, R_1, R_2, R_3, and R_4^+, the bars are all relatively short, generally below 15. Notably, the values for R_1 consistently exceed those for L_1 across all models, indicating a stronger contribution from the right context. A legend is provided in the top right corner.
